source.title: horror breathing
source.creator: primbal
source.prior_role_classification: idle_breath in the existing Chaos Assault Battalion receipt
source.alternate_encoding_note: The archive OGG is an alternate encoding of the same recording and is not another take. The WAV scan found direct clipping outside this crop; no near-rail samples were found in this selected interval.

crop.selection_basis: 50 ms RMS envelope shows a recorded low-to-high-to-low swell, approximately -22.2 dBFS at the initial trough, -5.2 dBFS near the peak, and -24.1 dBFS at the ending trough; direct source WAV rail scan found no near-rail samples in the interval.
crop.take_and_semantics_limit: A section of one recorded breathing file, not an independent take. Envelope evidence suggests a complete cycle, but waveform metrics cannot establish perceived cycle completeness or mutant-role fit.

mastering.processing: Recorded crop only: 30 Hz high-pass, mono downmix to 44100 Hz, trim start 0, 8 ms fade-in and 50 ms fade-out. The shared recorded loop master selected a measured 250 ms equal-power recorded head/tail overlap (effective output duration 0.95 s), applied EBU loudness normalization to -20 LUFS, with no measured limiter sample gain reduction. No silence, noise, tone, or external recording was added.

candidate.technical_limits: The existing loop inspector gates report <=20 ms lead, -20 LUFS +/-1, true peak <=-1 dBTP, no direct flat-top, and loop inner-edge RMS delta <=3 dB. This file passes those measured checks. Technical passage does not prove role fit or a perceptually clean loop.

acceptance_limits: Candidate only; no runtime install or definition wiring is included.
Parent/orchestrator must review whether the crop reads as a complete breath cycle and suits mutant low breathing.
The master creates a loop by overlapping the recorded crop's tail and head; listen for repetition, discontinuity, or audible crossfade artifacts.
This derivative remains one underlying recorded take, not a breathing pool or several takes.
